dashboard.label: Thresholds
dashboard.description: Effective threshold applied to every index, and the content of the lookup idxmon_thresholds. Edit the lookup with the Lookup Editor app (or the CSV in lookups/) - the first matching row wins, wildcards allowed, keep "*" last.

search.query: `idxmon_status` | table index threshold_minutes enabled severity owner comment | sort index | rename index as Index, threshold_minutes as "Threshold (min)", enabled as Enabled, severity as Severity, owner as Owner, comment as Comment
